subject: Re: BrightFlow OEM embedding — scope, pricing, and timeline
messages:
From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@brightflow.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@brightflow.ai
Date: Tue, 18 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: OEM embed for FlowStudio — initial questions

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. BrightFlow's product team really liked the low-latency completions and the embedding quality for search. We'd like to explore an OEM relationship where Redwood's inference runs inside our FlowStudio product (white-label). A few immediate questions from our side before we scope an SOW: 

- Packaging: do you offer an on-prem bundle we can ship as part of our appliance, or is the only option a private VPC connect?
- Telemetry & data: what events do you collect by default, and can we turn off telemetry for regulated customers?
- Pricing: are there per-seat or committed-usage models for OEMs versus standard API pricing?
- Support & SLAs: we need an enterprise SLA and a single point of contact during the POC.

I'm attaching a rough integration-scope spreadsheet and our legal team's high-level requirements.

Can we align on a short call this week to cover the technical/contract split and a 6–8 week PoC timeline?

Thanks —
Sarah
VP Product, BrightFlow Analytics
attachments: BrightFlow-Redwood-integration-scope.xlsx, OEM-Terms-Questions-v2.pdf

----
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@brightflow.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Nov 2025 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: OEM embed for FlowStudio — initial questions

Hi Sarah — great to hear the team liked the demo. I'm looping in Dylan from Partnerships to help scope commercial options and Lauren from Legal/Security will join once we get the PoC details. Quick answers to your bullets: 

- Packaging: We support three modes: hosted API (fastest), private VPC with dedicated nodes, and an on-prem appliance bundle for air-gapped customers (the appliance is a separate licensing add-on).
- Telemetry: default runtime collects anonymous performance metrics (latency, error rates). We can disable telemetry and ship a telemetry-free appliance; audit logs and usage reporting can be delivered to your SIEM if you choose.
- Pricing: OEMs typically combine a base platform fee + committed token usage (monthly) with overage pricing; per-seat models are possible for UI-locked experiences.
- Support & SLAs: we offer enterprise SLA packages with a named TAM for PoC and production (48-72hr response for P1 during PoC; tighter SLA post-contract).

Let's do a 30-min call Thurs 11/20 at 11am PT to walk the spreadsheet and confirm PoC success criteria. I've attached a short one-pager I use for OEM deals.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood-OEM-onepager.pdf

----
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@brightflow.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Nov 2025 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: OEM embed for FlowStudio — pricing sketch

Thanks for the call earlier — good alignment. Follow-up on pricing structure we discussed: 

Proposed (starter OEM):
- Setup fee: $75k (one-time) to cover private deployment, integration assistance, and security review.
- Commitment: $30k/month minimum for dedicated capacity (approx. baseline throughput for 2M tokens/mo).
- Overage: $0.0008 / token for additional usage.
- Term: 12 months (renewable), with quarterly business reviews.

Add-ons: on-prem appliance licensing +$150k one-time; extended SLA / 24x7 on-call +$12k/mo.

Action items we agreed:
1) BrightFlow to provide a sample dataset and traffic profile (to size dedicated nodes).
2) Redwood to deliver an integration runbook and POC acceptance criteria.

I'll send a pricing PDF and a link to the pilot checklist by EOD.

- Dylan
Director, Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood-OEM-pricing-sketch.pdf

----
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@brightflow.ai>
Cc: contracts@brightflow.ai
Date: Fri, 21 Nov 2025 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: OEM embed for FlowStudio — security & data controls

Hi Sarah,

Looping in a couple of points from our security and legal checklist: 

- Data handling: Redwood can support a config where customer content never leaves BrightFlow's VPC (private deployment) or an on-prem appliance. For hosted variants we provide strict contract clauses and SOC2 attestation.
- Telemetry & PII: telemetry is configurable; PII redaction is available as a validation layer during inference. We will need to agree on logging retention windows (default 90 days) or a custom retention schedule for regulated customers.
- IP & branding: OEM terms typically have a non-exclusive embedding license; BrightFlow may white-label the runtime but cannot redistribute the underlying model weights.

Please share any must-have security controls or audit language from your side and we'll incorporate into the SOW.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

----
From: Tom Chase <tchase@brightflow.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@brightflow.ai>, contracts@brightflow.ai
Date: Mon, 01 Dec 2025 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: BrightFlow redlines and a couple clarifying Qs

Alex/Team,

Attached are our initial redlines on the OEM term sheet (see OEM-Terms-Questions-v2.pdf). Two clarifying questions for your legal team before we escalate to signature: 

1) Can you confirm the exact scope of redistribution restrictions for the on-prem appliance? Our OEM legal is worried about a clause that looks like a broad non-compete.
2) For telemetry, we need a mechanism to prove telemetry is disabled in appliances (attestation report). Is that something you provide?

We're fine with the commercial sketch aside from one item: the setup fee. Can we discuss a phased setup fee tied to milestone acceptance?

Tom Chase
Head of GTM, BrightFlow
attachments: BF-redlines-20251201.pdf

----
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Tom Chase <tchase@brightflow.ai>, Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@brightflow.ai>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 02 Dec 2025 16:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: BrightFlow redlines and a couple clarifying Qs

Tom / Sarah — thanks for the redlines. Quick responses and next steps: 

- Redistribution: the appliance license permits BrightFlow to embed and distribute the appliance as part of FlowStudio to your customers, provided you do not expose or redistribute Redwood model weights or internal kernel source. We can add a narrowly scoped redistribution clause that clarifies permitted redistribution (installable product for end-customers only).
- Telemetry attestation: yes — we can provide a signed attestation for appliances confirming telemetry is disabled and a reproducible build checklist for your security team.
- Setup fee: happy to move to a milestone-based fee: 40% on kickoff, 40% on POC acceptance, 20% on GA.

Next steps:
1) Lauren will produce a draft OEM SOW that includes the attestation language and phased fees.
2) BrightFlow to share pilot dataset and traffic profile (see attachments).
3) I'll send the DocuSign envelope for the mutual NDA and the pilot SOW once Lauren has the draft (target by next Tue).

DocuSign (NDA): https://docusign.com/DocuSign/envelope/12345abcdef
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deals/BRIGHTFLOW-BF-0421

Appreciate the productive partnership — let's get the POC scheduled for the week of Dec 8.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
